title: A clock-capable role without Timesheets View can still see and open My Timesheets
custom_preconds: 1. A custom role that can clock in/out but does not have the Timesheets View permission exists, with a user assigned.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the clock-capable user who does not have Timesheets View.
custom_steps_separated.expected: You land on a page you are allowed to see and can reach the profile menu.
The My Timesheets item is shown.
The app opens the timesheets page without sending you to login or an unauthorized page.

custom_steps_separated.content: Switch to a mobile-size screen and open the mobile menu.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The My Timesheets item is shown there too.

evidence: UI (Technician = clockable, NO timesheetsView): /timesheets is accessible (not restricted) and shows the user My Timesheets entries — a clock-capable role without Timesheets View can still see and open My Timesheets. screenshot myts-tech.
